subject: Funds/Securities Balance
snippet: Dear Investor, With reference to NSE circulars NSE/INSP/46704 dated December 17, 2020, and NSE/INSP/55039 dated December 28, 2022, Trading members are required to upload clients' securities balance
body:
Dear Investor,


	With reference to NSE circulars NSE/INSP/46704 dated December 17, 2020, and NSE/INSP/55039 dated December 28, 2022, Trading members are required to upload clients' securities balance on a daily basis.


	Further, with reference to NCL circular NCL/CMPL/49348 dated Aug 20, 2021, and NSE circular NSE/INSP/49691 dated September 22, 2021, Members are required to upload disaggregated collateral information (segment-wise and asset type wise) at the client level to their Clearing corporations on a daily basis.


	Information pertaining to your fund and securities balance as on 16-05-2026 provided by GROWW INVEST TECH PRIVATE LIMITED along with the details of securities ISIN wise is attached.


	Please follow the procedure given below for opening the attachment:


	
 Click on the attachment provided with this mail.
 You will be prompted for your password.
 The password is your PAN number in upper case.
	
	Please note that negative number in the file represents debit balance/balance payable by you. Also, the funds and securities balances provided are what is maintained with your broker and does not include balance in your personal bank account and demat account.


	You are advised to compare the funds, securities and commodities balances received from Exchange on a weekly basis with the balances in the weekly statement of accounts for funds, securities and commodities sent by the stockbroker for the respective date. In case you find any discrepancy in the balances, we advise you to take up the matter immediately with your Broker.You may contact customer service of the trading member.


	In case of non-resolution of discrepancy by the broker, you may intimate the same to the Exchange at ignse@nse.co.in or 18002660050 or register an online complaint at https://smartodr.in/login.


	The data is being provided to the clients on an "as is" and "what-is" basis as provided by the trading member. The Exchange shall not be liable for any delays, errors, omissions, commissions, inaccuracies in rendering the data. In no event shall the Exchange be liable for any damages, including without limitation direct or indirect, special, incidental, or consequential damages, losses or expenses arising in connection with the data provided by the Exchange through this facility.


	You are requested to note that in the event of trading member being declared as defaulter/expelled, all transactions executed on the exchange trading platform within 90 calendar days prior to the effective date of disablement of the trading member or after the latest monthly/quarterly settlement date, if any, in respect of the claimant whichever is later shall be considered eligible for compensation from IPFT subject to Rules, Byelaws, Regulations, guidelines etc. of the Exchange and SEBI circulars and subject to the appropriate norms laid down by the relevant Committee. For details, you may refer the policy hosted on the website https://static.nseindia.com//s3fs-public/inline-files/Policy_for_evaluation_of_claims_0.pdf


	For Information & Education Purpose


	We would like to draw your attention to "SEBI vide circular dated April 04, 2022, wherein they have introduced the mechanism of “Demat Debit and Pledge Instruction (DDPI)”. The DDPI shall serve the same purpose of POA and significantly mitigate the misuse of POA. You should be aware that the stockbroker and depository participant cannot directly / indirectly compel the clients to execute the DDPI or deny services to the client if the client refuses to execute the DDPI.


	Please refer to SEBI Circular dated October 06, 2022, for the list of instructions which client can give to its stockbroker / depository participant. You may refer the following link for same: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/oct-2022/execution-of-demat-debit-and-pledge-instruction-ddpi-for-transfer-of-securities-towards-deliveries-settlement-obligations-and-pledging-re-pledging-of-securities-clarification_63724.html Should you wish to give any instructions, these need to be signed in physical against each purpose of DDPI. In case of an eSign option is made available, client should be given an option to choose the specific purpose(s) of DDPI".


 Dos and Don’ts for Retail Investors: 
	
 
 Please deal with SEBI registered intermediaries only. Ensure that you have complete knowledge of the products and the risks involved before investing.
 Offering fixed/guaranteed/regular returns/ capital protection schemes in stock markets whether written or oral is not allowed. Brokers or any of their representatives or Authorised Persons cannot enter into any loan agreement to pay interest on the funds/securities offered by you.
 Do not fall prey to emails, SMSs and online videos luring you to trade in stock/ securities / schemes promising high returns/profits.
 Ensure to fill all the required details in the 'KYC' document by yourself and receive duly signed copy of your 'KYC' documents from your broker.
 Trading in derivatives involves high risk and accordingly investors should understand the product well before trading in such segments/products.
 Opt for electronic (e-mail) contract notes/financial statements only if you are computer savvy and have your own e-mail account.
 Do not share your login ID, password, OTP, TPIN with any person including employees of the broker or Authorised Person under any circumstances.
 Ensure that all your trades are executed as per your instructions.
 Insure you receive the payout of funds and securities within 1 working day of settlement. In case you have chosen running account of funds, ensure your account is settled on first Friday/Saturday of every month / quarter as opted for.
 Dealing in cash is prohibited. Do not place any securities with the broker or associate of the broker or authorized person of the broker. Do not transfer securities as margin/ collateral to the broker and such securities only must be pledged from the client demat account.
 Opt for Demat Debit and Pledge Instruction (DDPI) only for transfer of securities for deliveries/settlement obligations, initiating pledging of securities for margins, and for mutual fund/open offer transactions on Exchange platform. DDPI/PoA are optional and should not be insisted on for opening the account.
 Always keep your mobile number and email id updated with your broker. Don't ignore any SMSs / e-mails with regards to contract notes/trades/funds and securities balances sent by broker/Exchange. Verify the details of the same and report discrepancy, if any, to your broker in writing immediately.
 Please verify the bank account details of the broker from the website of broker/Exchange before transferring funds to the broker. Starting October 1, 2025, you can make payments using standardized, validated, and exclusive UPI IDs. For more details: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jun-2025/adoption-of-standardised-validated-and-exclusive-upi-ids-for-payment-collection-by-sebi-registered-intermediaries-from-investors_94535.html
 Claims for funds or securities given to the broker under any arrangement/ agreement of indicative return or claims for funds, without transactions on the Exchange will not be accepted by the Exchange in case of default by your broker.
 For more details on Investor awareness, please visit-www.nseindia.com/invest/investors-home
 For more information related to investments in securities market, please visit SEBI Investor Website - https://investor.sebi.gov.in and SEBI Saa₹thi Mobile App.
 
	
 


 निवेशक क्या करें और क्या न करें: 
	
 
 कृपया सिर्फ सेबी के यहां रजिस्टर्ड इंटरमीडयरीज़ के साथ ही डील करें। निवेश करने से पहले तय कर लें कि आप प्रोडक्ट्स तथा सम्बंधित जोखिम के बारे में पूरी जानकारी रखते हैं।
 स्टॉक मार्केट में लिखित या मौखिक रूप से फिक्स्ड/ गारेंटेड/रेग्युलर रिटर्न्स/कैपिटल प्रोटेक्शन स्कीमों की ऑफर करने की अनुमति नहीं है। ब्रोकर्स या उनके किसी भी प्रतिनिधि या प्राधिकृत व्यक्तियों द्वारा आपके द्वारा ऑफर किए जाने वाले फंड्स /सिक्योरीटीज़ पर ब्याज के भुगतान के लिए लोन समझौता नहीं किया जा सकता है।
 हाई रिटर्न/लाभ का वादा करने वाले स्टॉक/सिक्योरीटीज़/स्कीमों में ट्रेड करने का लालच देने वाली ईमेल, एसएमएस तथा ऑनलाइन वीडियो पर भरोसा न करें।
 ‘केवाईसी’ दस्तावेज़ में सभी आवश्यक ब्यौरा स्वयं ही भरें और अपने ब्रोकर से अपने ‘केवाईसी’ दस्तावेज़ों की विधिवत रूप से साइन की गई प्रति को प्राप्त करें।
 डेरिवेटिवट्रेडिंग में जोखिम होसकते हैं और निवेशकोंको किसी भी सम्बंधितउत्पाद में ट्रेड करनेसे पूर्व उसका पूर्ण ज्ञानऔर जानकारी लेना आवश्यक है |
 यदि आप कम्प्यूटर से बहुत भली-भांति परिचित हैं तथा आपका अपना ई-मेल अकाउंट है, केवल तभी ही इलेक्ट्रोनिक (ई-मेल) कॉन्ट्रेक्ट नोट्स / फाईनेंशियल स्टेटमेंट्स का विकल्प चुनें।
 किसी भी स्थिति में ब्रोकर के कर्मचारी या प्राधिकृत व्यक्ति सहित किसी भी व्यक्ति के साथ अपनी लॉगिन आईडी, पासवर्ड, ओटीपी और टी-पिन को साझा न करें।
 तय करें कि आपके सभी ट्रेड्स को आपके निर्देशों के अनुसार ही किया जाता है। एनएसई वेबसाइट पर ट्रेड वेरिफिकेशन सुविधा उपलब्ध है जिसे आपकी तरफ से किए गए ट्रेड्स को वेरीफाई करने के लिए इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं।
 सुनिश्चित करें कि सेटलमेंट के 1 दिन के अंदर आपको फंड्स तथा सिक्योरीटीज़ का पेआउट मिल जाता है। यदि आपने फंड्स के रनिंग अकाउंट्स को चुना है, तो सुनिश्चित करें कि जैसा विकल्प चुना गया है, उसी के अनुसार आपके अकाउंट को हर महीने /तिमाही के पहले शुक्रवार/शनिवार को सेटल कर दिया जाता है।
 नकद सौदेबाजी प्रतिबंधित है। किसी भी सिक्योरीटीज़ को ब्रोकर या ब्रोकर के एसोसिएट या ब्रोकर के प्राधिकृत व्यक्ति को न दें। मार्जिन /कोलेट्रल के तौर पर सिक्योरीटीज़ को ब्रोकर को ट्रांसफर न करें तथा इस प्रकार की सिक्योरीटीज़ को केवल क्लाइंट डिमेट अकाउंट से ही प्लेज किया जाना चाहिए।
 डिलीवरी/सेटलमेंट बाध्यताओं के लिए सिक्योरीटीज़ के ट्रांसफर, मार्जिन के लिए सिक्योरीटीज़ को प्लेज करने की शुरुआत करने, तथा एक्सचेंज प्लेटफॉर्म पर म्यूचल फंड/ओपन ऑफर लेनदेनों के लिए ही डीडीपीआई (डिमेट डेबिट एण्ड प्लेज इंस्ट्रक्शन) का विकल्प चुनें। डीडीपीआई /पीओए वैकल्पिक हैं और अकाउंट खोलने के लिए उनके लिए जबरदस्ती नहीं की जानी चाहिए।
 अपने ब्रोकर के पास हमेशा अपने मोबाइल नम्बर तथा ईमेल आईडी को अपडेट रखें। ब्रोकर/एक्सचेंज द्वारा कॉन्ट्रेक्ट नोट्स/ट्रेड्स/फंड्स तथा सिक्योरीटीज़ बैलेंस के लिए भेजे गए एसएमएस /ईमेल को कभी भी नज़रअंदाज न करें। उसके ब्यौरे को सत्यापित कर लें और यदि कोई फर्क नज़र आता है, तो तत्काल अपने ब्रोकर को लिखित में उसकी सूचना दें।
 ब्रोकर को फंड्स ट्रांसफर करने से पहले ब्रोकर के बैंक अकाउंट ब्यौरे का सत्यापन ब्रोकर/एक्सचेंज की वेबसाइट से कर लें।1 अक्टूबर 2025 से आप मानकीकृत, सत्यापित और विशेष UPI आईडी का उपयोग करके भुगतान कर सकते हैं। अधिक जानकारी के लिए देखें: SEBI सर्कुलर लिंक: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jun-2025/adoption-of-standardised-validated-and-exclusive-upi-ids-for-payment-collection-by-sebi-registered-intermediaries-from-investors_94535.html
 एक्सचेंज में लेनदेन के बिना, ब्रोकर को किसी भी समझौते/ भावी रिटर्न के समझौते या फंड्स के दावों के लिए दिए गए फंड्स या सिक्योरीटीज़ के दावों को एक्सचेंज द्वारा स्वीकार नहीं किया जाएगा यदि आपका ब्रोकर कोई डिफाल्ट करता है।
 निवेशक जागरूकता के संबंध में अधिक ब्यौरे के लिए कृपया निम्नलिखित को देखें-www.nseindia.com/invest/investors-home
 प्रतिभूति बाजार में निवेश से संबंधित अधिक जानकारी के लिए कृपया सेबी निवेशक वेबसाइट https://investor.sebi.gov.in/ और सेबी सा₹थी / Saa₹thi मोबाइल ऐप पर जाएं।
 
	
	We are glad to inform you that NSE for your convenience/comfort is providing links below on investment concepts, investor alerts, your rights and obligation as an investor.


	www.nseindia.com/invest/first-time-investor-know-your-rights
	www.nseindia.com/invest/first-time-investor-fraud-dos-and-donts
	www.nseindia.com/invest/file-a-complaint-online
	You may also visit our website www.nseindia.com for any further information that you may require or email your queries to the email ID ignse@nse.co.in, quoting the name of your city in the subject. We would be glad to assist you.


	Information to investors:


	Exchange has introduced trading in Rights Entitlement w.e.f. May 20, 2020. The trades executed, if any, for Rights Entitlement in Capital Market shall form part of the attached file. Rights Entitlement should not be mistaken for ordinary shares and unless Rights Entitlement are exercised they will lose value and no rights (shares) will be available to the investor. The buyer of the Rights Entitlement is required to subscribe for the same before the Issue Closing Date, else the same will lapse and no shares will be allotted.


	In case you need any clarification, please feel free to call on our toll-free number 1800 266 0050 (select option 5 - UCI & Trade Alerts). You can also email us at uci@nse.co.in, quoting your PAN, Mobile no. and your query.

 With reference to BSE notices 20210922-64 dated September 22, 2021 and 20211022-44 dated October 22, 2021, Stock Brokers are required to upload segregation and monitoring of collateral at client level on daily basis.

 BSE Limited

 Do's & Dont's

 1. Deal only with registered intermediaries - check the registration certificate of the intermediary you are dealing with. It allows recourse to regulatory action.

 2. Beware of fixed/guaranteed returns schemes. Brokers or any of their representatives are not authorized to offer fixed/guaranteed returns on your investment or enter into any loan agreement to pay interest on the funds/securities offered by you.

 3. Do not fall prey to emails and SMSs luring you to trade in stock/ securities promising huge profits.

 4. Ensure to fill all the required details in KYC document by yourself and receive duly signed copy of your KYC documents from your broker. Check for all conditions that have been agreed and accepted by you.

 5. Opt for electronic (e-mail) contract notes/financial statements only if you are computer savvy and have an e-mail account of your own. Don't ignore any e-mails/SMSs received with regards to trades done by you. Verify the details of the same and report discrepancy, if any, to your broker in writing immediately

 6. Trade verification facility is also available on BSE website.

 7. Check the frequency of accounts settlement opted for and verify your monthly/quarterly settlement statements. Any discrepancies observed therein should be brought to the notice of your broker in writing immediately.

Top questions about airport rides



























 
 











 



How much will my airport ride cost?


The cost of your trip depends on several factors, including the type of ride you request, tolls, the length/duration of the trip, and current demand.


















 
 











 



What vehicles are available for airport trips?


Available ride options depend on your location and airport regulations.

subject: Funds/Securities Balance
snippet: Dear Investor, With reference to NSE circulars NSE/INSP/46704 dated December 17, 2020, and NSE/INSP/55039 dated December 28, 2022, Trading members are required to upload clients' securities balance
body:
Dear Investor,


	With reference to NSE circulars NSE/INSP/46704 dated December 17, 2020, and NSE/INSP/55039 dated December 28, 2022, Trading members are required to upload clients' securities balance on a daily basis.


	Further, with reference to NCL circular NCL/CMPL/49348 dated Aug 20, 2021, and NSE circular NSE/INSP/49691 dated September 22, 2021, Members are required to upload disaggregated collateral information (segment-wise and asset type wise) at the client level to their Clearing corporations on a daily basis.


	Information pertaining to your fund and securities balance as on {{last_date_of_saturday}} provided by {{tm_name}} along with the details of securities ISIN wise is attached.


	Please follow the procedure given below for opening the attachment:


	
 Click on the attachment provided with this mail.
 You will be prompted for your password.
 The password is your PAN number in upper case.
	
	Please note that negative number in the file represents debit balance/balance payable by you. Also, the funds and securities balances provided are what is maintained with your broker and does not include balance in your personal bank account and demat account.


	You are advised to compare the funds, securities and commodities balances received from Exchange on a weekly basis with the balances in the weekly statement of accounts for funds, securities and commodities sent by the stockbroker for the respective date. In case you find any discrepancy in the balances, we advise you to take up the matter immediately with your Broker.You may contact customer service of the trading member.


	In case of non-resolution of discrepancy by the broker, you may intimate the same to the Exchange at ignse@nse.co.in or 18002660050 or register an online complaint at https://smartodr.in/login.


	The data is being provided to the clients on an "as is" and "what-is" basis as provided by the trading member. The Exchange shall not be liable for any delays, errors, omissions, commissions, inaccuracies in rendering the data. In no event shall the Exchange be liable for any damages, including without limitation direct or indirect, special, incidental, or consequential damages, losses or expenses arising in connection with the data provided by the Exchange through this facility.


	You are requested to note that in the event of trading member being declared as defaulter/expelled, all transactions executed on the exchange trading platform within 90 calendar days prior to the effective date of disablement of the trading member or after the latest monthly/quarterly settlement date, if any, in respect of the claimant whichever is later shall be considered eligible for compensation from IPFT subject to Rules, Byelaws, Regulations, guidelines etc. of the Exchange and SEBI circulars and subject to the appropriate norms laid down by the relevant Committee. For details, you may refer the policy hosted on the website https://static.nseindia.com//s3fs-public/inline-files/Policy_for_evaluation_of_claims_0.pdf


	For Information & Education Purpose


	We would like to draw your attention to "SEBI vide circular dated April 04, 2022, wherein they have introduced the mechanism of “Demat Debit and Pledge Instruction (DDPI)”. The DDPI shall serve the same purpose of POA and significantly mitigate the misuse of POA. You should be aware that the stockbroker and depository participant cannot directly / indirectly compel the clients to execute the DDPI or deny services to the client if the client refuses to execute the DDPI.


	Please refer to SEBI Circular dated October 06, 2022, for the list of instructions which client can give to its stockbroker / depository participant. You may refer the following link for same: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/oct-2022/execution-of-demat-debit-and-pledge-instruction-ddpi-for-transfer-of-securities-towards-deliveries-settlement-obligations-and-pledging-re-pledging-of-securities-clarification_63724.html Should you wish to give any instructions, these need to be signed in physical against each purpose of DDPI. In case of an eSign option is made available, client should be given an option to choose the specific purpose(s) of DDPI".


 Dos and Don’ts for Retail Investors: 
	
 
 Please deal with SEBI registered intermediaries only. Ensure that you have complete knowledge of the products and the risks involved before investing.
 Offering fixed/guaranteed/regular returns/ capital protection schemes in stock markets whether written or oral is not allowed. Brokers or any of their representatives or Authorised Persons cannot enter into any loan agreement to pay interest on the funds/securities offered by you.
 Do not fall prey to emails, SMSs and online videos luring you to trade in stock/ securities / schemes promising high returns/profits.
 Ensure to fill all the required details in the 'KYC' document by yourself and receive duly signed copy of your 'KYC' documents from your broker.
 Trading in derivatives involves high risk and accordingly investors should understand the product well before trading in such segments/products.
 Opt for electronic (e-mail) contract notes/financial statements only if you are computer savvy and have your own e-mail account.
 Do not share your login ID, password, OTP, TPIN with any person including employees of the broker or Authorised Person under any circumstances.
 Ensure that all your trades are executed as per your instructions.
 Insure you receive the payout of funds and securities within 1 working day of settlement. In case you have chosen running account of funds, ensure your account is settled on first Friday/Saturday of every month / quarter as opted for.
 Dealing in cash is prohibited. Do not place any securities with the broker or associate of the broker or authorized person of the broker. Do not transfer securities as margin/ collateral to the broker and such securities only must be pledged from the client demat account.
 Opt for Demat Debit and Pledge Instruction (DDPI) only for transfer of securities for deliveries/settlement obligations, initiating pledging of securities for margins, and for mutual fund/open offer transactions on Exchange platform. DDPI/PoA are optional and should not be insisted on for opening the account.
 Always keep your mobile number and email id updated with your broker. Don't ignore any SMSs / e-mails with regards to contract notes/trades/funds and securities balances sent by broker/Exchange. Verify the details of the same and report discrepancy, if any, to your broker in writing immediately.
 Please verify the bank account details of the broker from the website of broker/Exchange before transferring funds to the broker. Starting October 1, 2025, you can make payments using standardized, validated, and exclusive UPI IDs. For more details: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jun-2025/adoption-of-standardised-validated-and-exclusive-upi-ids-for-payment-collection-by-sebi-registered-intermediaries-from-investors_94535.html
 Claims for funds or securities given to the broker under any arrangement/ agreement of indicative return or claims for funds, without transactions on the Exchange will not be accepted by the Exchange in case of default by your broker.
 For more details on Investor awareness, please visit-www.nseindia.com/invest/investors-home
 For more information related to investments in securities market, please visit SEBI Investor Website - https://investor.sebi.gov.in and SEBI Saa₹thi Mobile App.
 
	
 


 निवेशक क्या करें और क्या न करें: 
	
 
 कृपया सिर्फ सेबी के यहां रजिस्टर्ड इंटरमीडयरीज़ के साथ ही डील करें। निवेश करने से पहले तय कर लें कि आप प्रोडक्ट्स तथा सम्बंधित जोखिम के बारे में पूरी जानकारी रखते हैं।
 स्टॉक मार्केट में लिखित या मौखिक रूप से फिक्स्ड/ गारेंटेड/रेग्युलर रिटर्न्स/कैपिटल प्रोटेक्शन स्कीमों की ऑफर करने की अनुमति नहीं है। ब्रोकर्स या उनके किसी भी प्रतिनिधि या प्राधिकृत व्यक्तियों द्वारा आपके द्वारा ऑफर किए जाने वाले फंड्स /सिक्योरीटीज़ पर ब्याज के भुगतान के लिए लोन समझौता नहीं किया जा सकता है।
 हाई रिटर्न/लाभ का वादा करने वाले स्टॉक/सिक्योरीटीज़/स्कीमों में ट्रेड करने का लालच देने वाली ईमेल, एसएमएस तथा ऑनलाइन वीडियो पर भरोसा न करें।
 ‘केवाईसी’ दस्तावेज़ में सभी आवश्यक ब्यौरा स्वयं ही भरें और अपने ब्रोकर से अपने ‘केवाईसी’ दस्तावेज़ों की विधिवत रूप से साइन की गई प्रति को प्राप्त करें।
 डेरिवेटिवट्रेडिंग में जोखिम होसकते हैं और निवेशकोंको किसी भी सम्बंधितउत्पाद में ट्रेड करनेसे पूर्व उसका पूर्ण ज्ञानऔर जानकारी लेना आवश्यक है |
 यदि आप कम्प्यूटर से बहुत भली-भांति परिचित हैं तथा आपका अपना ई-मेल अकाउंट है, केवल तभी ही इलेक्ट्रोनिक (ई-मेल) कॉन्ट्रेक्ट नोट्स / फाईनेंशियल स्टेटमेंट्स का विकल्प चुनें।
 किसी भी स्थिति में ब्रोकर के कर्मचारी या प्राधिकृत व्यक्ति सहित किसी भी व्यक्ति के साथ अपनी लॉगिन आईडी, पासवर्ड, ओटीपी और टी-पिन को साझा न करें।
 तय करें कि आपके सभी ट्रेड्स को आपके निर्देशों के अनुसार ही किया जाता है। एनएसई वेबसाइट पर ट्रेड वेरिफिकेशन सुविधा उपलब्ध है जिसे आपकी तरफ से किए गए ट्रेड्स को वेरीफाई करने के लिए इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं।
 सुनिश्चित करें कि सेटलमेंट के 1 दिन के अंदर आपको फंड्स तथा सिक्योरीटीज़ का पेआउट मिल जाता है। यदि आपने फंड्स के रनिंग अकाउंट्स को चुना है, तो सुनिश्चित करें कि जैसा विकल्प चुना गया है, उसी के अनुसार आपके अकाउंट को हर महीने /तिमाही के पहले शुक्रवार/शनिवार को सेटल कर दिया जाता है।
 नकद सौदेबाजी प्रतिबंधित है। किसी भी सिक्योरीटीज़ को ब्रोकर या ब्रोकर के एसोसिएट या ब्रोकर के प्राधिकृत व्यक्ति को न दें। मार्जिन /कोलेट्रल के तौर पर सिक्योरीटीज़ को ब्रोकर को ट्रांसफर न करें तथा इस प्रकार की सिक्योरीटीज़ को केवल क्लाइंट डिमेट अकाउंट से ही प्लेज किया जाना चाहिए।
 डिलीवरी/सेटलमेंट बाध्यताओं के लिए सिक्योरीटीज़ के ट्रांसफर, मार्जिन के लिए सिक्योरीटीज़ को प्लेज करने की शुरुआत करने, तथा एक्सचेंज प्लेटफॉर्म पर म्यूचल फंड/ओपन ऑफर लेनदेनों के लिए ही डीडीपीआई (डिमेट डेबिट एण्ड प्लेज इंस्ट्रक्शन) का विकल्प चुनें। डीडीपीआई /पीओए वैकल्पिक हैं और अकाउंट खोलने के लिए उनके लिए जबरदस्ती नहीं की जानी चाहिए।
 अपने ब्रोकर के पास हमेशा अपने मोबाइल नम्बर तथा ईमेल आईडी को अपडेट रखें। ब्रोकर/एक्सचेंज द्वारा कॉन्ट्रेक्ट नोट्स/ट्रेड्स/फंड्स तथा सिक्योरीटीज़ बैलेंस के लिए भेजे गए एसएमएस /ईमेल को कभी भी नज़रअंदाज न करें। उसके ब्यौरे को सत्यापित कर लें और यदि कोई फर्क नज़र आता है, तो तत्काल अपने ब्रोकर को लिखित में उसकी सूचना दें।
 ब्रोकर को फंड्स ट्रांसफर करने से पहले ब्रोकर के बैंक अकाउंट ब्यौरे का सत्यापन ब्रोकर/एक्सचेंज की वेबसाइट से कर लें।1 अक्टूबर 2025 से आप मानकीकृत, सत्यापित और विशेष UPI आईडी का उपयोग करके भुगतान कर सकते हैं। अधिक जानकारी के लिए देखें: SEBI सर्कुलर लिंक: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jun-2025/adoption-of-standardised-validated-and-exclusive-upi-ids-for-payment-collection-by-sebi-registered-intermediaries-from-investors_94535.html
 एक्सचेंज में लेनदेन के बिना, ब्रोकर को किसी भी समझौते/ भावी रिटर्न के समझौते या फंड्स के दावों के लिए दिए गए फंड्स या सिक्योरीटीज़ के दावों को एक्सचेंज द्वारा स्वीकार नहीं किया जाएगा यदि आपका ब्रोकर कोई डिफाल्ट करता है।
 निवेशक जागरूकता के संबंध में अधिक ब्यौरे के लिए कृपया निम्नलिखित को देखें-www.nseindia.com/invest/investors-home
 प्रतिभूति बाजार में निवेश से संबंधित अधिक जानकारी के लिए कृपया सेबी निवेशक वेबसाइट https://investor.sebi.gov.in/ और सेबी सा₹थी / Saa₹thi मोबाइल ऐप पर जाएं।
 
	
	We are glad to inform you that NSE for your convenience/comfort is providing links below on investment concepts, investor alerts, your rights and obligation as an investor.


	www.nseindia.com/invest/first-time-investor-know-your-rights
	www.nseindia.com/invest/first-time-investor-fraud-dos-and-donts
	www.nseindia.com/invest/file-a-complaint-online
	You may also visit our website www.nseindia.com for any further information that you may require or email your queries to the email ID ignse@nse.co.in, quoting the name of your city in the subject. We would be glad to assist you.


	Information to investors:


	Exchange has introduced trading in Rights Entitlement w.e.f. May 20, 2020. The trades executed, if any, for Rights Entitlement in Capital Market shall form part of the attached file. Rights Entitlement should not be mistaken for ordinary shares and unless Rights Entitlement are exercised they will lose value and no rights (shares) will be available to the investor. The buyer of the Rights Entitlement is required to subscribe for the same before the Issue Closing Date, else the same will lapse and no shares will be allotted.


	In case you need any clarification, please feel free to call on our toll-free number 1800 266 0050 (select option 5 - UCI & Trade Alerts). You can also email us at uci@nse.co.in, quoting your PAN, Mobile no. and your query.


	To learn more about Personal Finance, securities market, details of upcoming Investor Awareness Programs and more, please visit the SEBI Investor website at https://investor.sebi.gov.in


	Thanks and Regards,
National Stock Exchange of India Limited

subject: Funds / Securities Balance
snippet: Dear Investor, With reference to BSE notices 20210922-64 dated September 22, 2021 and 20211022-44 dated October 22, 2021, Stock Brokers are required to upload segregation and monitoring of collateral
body:
Dear Investor,
 
 
 
  
 
 
 With reference to BSE notices 20210922-64 dated September 22, 2021 and 20211022-44 dated October 22, 2021, Stock Brokers are required to upload segregation and monitoring of collateral at client level on daily basis.
 
 
  
 
 
 
 Your Stockbroker GROWW INVEST TECH PRIVATE LIMITED has reported the details of Funds balance and Securities balance as on 25/04/2026 to Clearing Corporations, is attached.
 
 
 
 Please follow the procedure given below for opening the attachment:
 
 
          1. Click on the attachment provided with this email.
          2. You will be prompted for your password.
          3. The password is your PAN in upper case
 
 
  
 
 
 
 Please note that negative number in the file represents debit balance/balance payable by you. Also, the funds and securities balances provided are what is maintained with your broker and does not include balance in your personal bank account and demat account.
 
 
 
 Yours faithfully,
 
 
  
 
 
 
 BSE Limited
 
 
  
 
 
 In case you find any discrepancy, we advise you to take up the matter immediately with your member. You may contact your stock broker at SUPPORT@GROWW.IN or 9108800604.                             
 
 
 
 
 
 Investor may follow the BSE Social Media Handles for Investor education: 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/bseindia
 Twitter: https://twitter.com/BSEIndia
 YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/BSEworld
 Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/bseindia
 Instagram: http://instagram.com/bseindia

 
 
 
 
 Do's & Dont's

 1. Deal only with registered intermediaries - check the registration certificate of the intermediary you are dealing with. It allows recourse to regulatory action.

 2. Beware of fixed/guaranteed returns schemes. Brokers or any of their representatives are not authorized to offer fixed/guaranteed returns on your investment or enter into any loan agreement to pay interest on the funds/securities offered by you.

 3. Do not fall prey to emails and SMSs luring you to trade in stock/ securities promising huge profits.

 4. Ensure to fill all the required details in KYC document by yourself and receive duly signed copy of your KYC documents from your broker. Check for all conditions that have been agreed and accepted by you.

 5. Opt for electronic (e-mail) contract notes/financial statements only if you are computer savvy and have an e-mail account of your own. Don't ignore any e-mails/SMSs received with regards to trades done by you. Verify the details of the same and report discrepancy, if any, to your broker in writing immediately

 6. Trade verification facility is also available on BSE website.

 7. Check the frequency of accounts settlement opted for and verify your monthly/quarterly settlement statements. Any discrepancies observed therein should be brought to the notice of your broker in writing immediately.                  
 
 
 
                                                                  
 
 
 
 
 For Awareness of Investors –
 
 
  
 
 
 निवेशकों की जागरूकता के लिए –
 
 
  
 
 
 You are requested to take note of the Exchange’s norms with respect to claims against trading members who have been declared as defaulters. The said norms are available on Exchange website under Investor section. The link of the same is given below:
 
 
  
 
 
 आपसे अनुरोध है कि ट्रेडिंग मेंबर जिन्हें डिफॉल्टर घोषित किया गया है उनके खिलाफ दावे के संबंध में आप एक्सचेंज के मानदंडों का ध्यान रखें |उक्त मानदंड एक्सचेंज कि वेबसाइट पर उपलब्ध हैं | उसी का लिंक नीचे दिया गया है: 
 
 
  
 
 
 Norms with respect to claims against Trading members who disabled / suspended /declared defaulter prior to September 4, 2022: 
 
 
  
 
 
 4 सितंबर, 2022 से पहले अक्षम / निलंबित / डिफॉल्टर घोषित किये गए ट्रेडिंग मेंबर के खिलाफ दावों के संबंध में मानदंड:

 Amended Norms with respect to claims against Trading members who disabled / suspended /declared defaulter post September 4, 2022:

 https://www.bseindia.com/markets/MarketInfo/DispNewNoticesCirculars.aspx?page=20220819-32
 
 
  
 
 
 The list of trading members who have been declared as defaulters is available at the following link:

IOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/cdsl-myeasi-app/id6737304195

subject: Funds/Securities Balance
snippet: Dear Investor, With reference to NSE circulars NSE/INSP/46704 dated December 17, 2020, and NSE/INSP/55039 dated December 28, 2022, Trading members are required to upload clients' securities balance
body:
Dear Investor,


	With reference to NSE circulars NSE/INSP/46704 dated December 17, 2020, and NSE/INSP/55039 dated December 28, 2022, Trading members are required to upload clients' securities balance on a daily basis.


	Further, with reference to NCL circular NCL/CMPL/49348 dated Aug 20, 2021, and NSE circular NSE/INSP/49691 dated September 22, 2021, Members are required to upload disaggregated collateral information (segment-wise and asset type wise) at the client level to their Clearing corporations on a daily basis.


	Information pertaining to your fund and securities balance as on {{last_date_of_saturday}} provided by {{tm_name}} along with the details of securities ISIN wise is attached.


	Please follow the procedure given below for opening the attachment:


	
 Click on the attachment provided with this mail.
 You will be prompted for your password.
 The password is your PAN number in upper case.
	
	Please note that negative number in the file represents debit balance/balance payable by you. Also, the funds and securities balances provided are what is maintained with your broker and does not include balance in your personal bank account and demat account.


	You are advised to compare the funds, securities and commodities balances received from Exchange on a weekly basis with the balances in the weekly statement of accounts for funds, securities and commodities sent by the stockbroker for the respective date. In case you find any discrepancy in the balances, we advise you to take up the matter immediately with your Broker.You may contact customer service of the trading member.


	In case of non-resolution of discrepancy by the broker, you may intimate the same to the Exchange at ignse@nse.co.in or 18002660050 or register an online complaint at https://smartodr.in/login.


	The data is being provided to the clients on an "as is" and "what-is" basis as provided by the trading member. The Exchange shall not be liable for any delays, errors, omissions, commissions, inaccuracies in rendering the data. In no event shall the Exchange be liable for any damages, including without limitation direct or indirect, special, incidental, or consequential damages, losses or expenses arising in connection with the data provided by the Exchange through this facility.


	You are requested to note that in the event of trading member being declared as defaulter/expelled, all transactions executed on the exchange trading platform within 90 calendar days prior to the effective date of disablement of the trading member or after the latest monthly/quarterly settlement date, if any, in respect of the claimant whichever is later shall be considered eligible for compensation from IPFT subject to Rules, Byelaws, Regulations, guidelines etc. of the Exchange and SEBI circulars and subject to the appropriate norms laid down by the relevant Committee. For details, you may refer the policy hosted on the website https://static.nseindia.com//s3fs-public/inline-files/Policy_for_evaluation_of_claims_0.pdf


	For Information & Education Purpose


	We would like to draw your attention to "SEBI vide circular dated April 04, 2022, wherein they have introduced the mechanism of “Demat Debit and Pledge Instruction (DDPI)”. The DDPI shall serve the same purpose of POA and significantly mitigate the misuse of POA. You should be aware that the stockbroker and depository participant cannot directly / indirectly compel the clients to execute the DDPI or deny services to the client if the client refuses to execute the DDPI.


	Please refer to SEBI Circular dated October 06, 2022, for the list of instructions which client can give to its stockbroker / depository participant. You may refer the following link for same: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/oct-2022/execution-of-demat-debit-and-pledge-instruction-ddpi-for-transfer-of-securities-towards-deliveries-settlement-obligations-and-pledging-re-pledging-of-securities-clarification_63724.html Should you wish to give any instructions, these need to be signed in physical against each purpose of DDPI. In case of an eSign option is made available, client should be given an option to choose the specific purpose(s) of DDPI".


 Dos and Don’ts for Retail Investors: 
	
 
 Please deal with SEBI registered intermediaries only. Ensure that you have complete knowledge of the products and the risks involved before investing.
 Offering fixed/guaranteed/regular returns/ capital protection schemes in stock markets whether written or oral is not allowed. Brokers or any of their representatives or Authorised Persons cannot enter into any loan agreement to pay interest on the funds/securities offered by you.
 Do not fall prey to emails, SMSs and online videos luring you to trade in stock/ securities / schemes promising high returns/profits.
 Ensure to fill all the required details in the 'KYC' document by yourself and receive duly signed copy of your 'KYC' documents from your broker.
 Trading in derivatives involves high risk and accordingly investors should understand the product well before trading in such segments/products.
 Opt for electronic (e-mail) contract notes/financial statements only if you are computer savvy and have your own e-mail account.
 Do not share your login ID, password, OTP, TPIN with any person including employees of the broker or Authorised Person under any circumstances.
 Ensure that all your trades are executed as per your instructions.
 Insure you receive the payout of funds and securities within 1 working day of settlement. In case you have chosen running account of funds, ensure your account is settled on first Friday/Saturday of every month / quarter as opted for.
 Dealing in cash is prohibited. Do not place any securities with the broker or associate of the broker or authorized person of the broker. Do not transfer securities as margin/ collateral to the broker and such securities only must be pledged from the client demat account.
 Opt for Demat Debit and Pledge Instruction (DDPI) only for transfer of securities for deliveries/settlement obligations, initiating pledging of securities for margins, and for mutual fund/open offer transactions on Exchange platform. DDPI/PoA are optional and should not be insisted on for opening the account.
 Always keep your mobile number and email id updated with your broker. Don't ignore any SMSs / e-mails with regards to contract notes/trades/funds and securities balances sent by broker/Exchange. Verify the details of the same and report discrepancy, if any, to your broker in writing immediately.
 Please verify the bank account details of the broker from the website of broker/Exchange before transferring funds to the broker. Starting October 1, 2025, you can make payments using standardized, validated, and exclusive UPI IDs. For more details: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jun-2025/adoption-of-standardised-validated-and-exclusive-upi-ids-for-payment-collection-by-sebi-registered-intermediaries-from-investors_94535.html
 Claims for funds or securities given to the broker under any arrangement/ agreement of indicative return or claims for funds, without transactions on the Exchange will not be accepted by the Exchange in case of default by your broker.
 For more details on Investor awareness, please visit-www.nseindia.com/invest/investors-home
 For more information related to investments in securities market, please visit SEBI Investor Website - https://investor.sebi.gov.in and SEBI Saa₹thi Mobile App.
 
	
 


 निवेशक क्या करें और क्या न करें: 
	
 
 कृपया सिर्फ सेबी के यहां रजिस्टर्ड इंटरमीडयरीज़ के साथ ही डील करें। निवेश करने से पहले तय कर लें कि आप प्रोडक्ट्स तथा सम्बंधित जोखिम के बारे में पूरी जानकारी रखते हैं।
 स्टॉक मार्केट में लिखित या मौखिक रूप से फिक्स्ड/ गारेंटेड/रेग्युलर रिटर्न्स/कैपिटल प्रोटेक्शन स्कीमों की ऑफर करने की अनुमति नहीं है। ब्रोकर्स या उनके किसी भी प्रतिनिधि या प्राधिकृत व्यक्तियों द्वारा आपके द्वारा ऑफर किए जाने वाले फंड्स /सिक्योरीटीज़ पर ब्याज के भुगतान के लिए लोन समझौता नहीं किया जा सकता है।
 हाई रिटर्न/लाभ का वादा करने वाले स्टॉक/सिक्योरीटीज़/स्कीमों में ट्रेड करने का लालच देने वाली ईमेल, एसएमएस तथा ऑनलाइन वीडियो पर भरोसा न करें।
 ‘केवाईसी’ दस्तावेज़ में सभी आवश्यक ब्यौरा स्वयं ही भरें और अपने ब्रोकर से अपने ‘केवाईसी’ दस्तावेज़ों की विधिवत रूप से साइन की गई प्रति को प्राप्त करें।
 डेरिवेटिवट्रेडिंग में जोखिम होसकते हैं और निवेशकोंको किसी भी सम्बंधितउत्पाद में ट्रेड करनेसे पूर्व उसका पूर्ण ज्ञानऔर जानकारी लेना आवश्यक है |
 यदि आप कम्प्यूटर से बहुत भली-भांति परिचित हैं तथा आपका अपना ई-मेल अकाउंट है, केवल तभी ही इलेक्ट्रोनिक (ई-मेल) कॉन्ट्रेक्ट नोट्स / फाईनेंशियल स्टेटमेंट्स का विकल्प चुनें।
 किसी भी स्थिति में ब्रोकर के कर्मचारी या प्राधिकृत व्यक्ति सहित किसी भी व्यक्ति के साथ अपनी लॉगिन आईडी, पासवर्ड, ओटीपी और टी-पिन को साझा न करें।
 तय करें कि आपके सभी ट्रेड्स को आपके निर्देशों के अनुसार ही किया जाता है। एनएसई वेबसाइट पर ट्रेड वेरिफिकेशन सुविधा उपलब्ध है जिसे आपकी तरफ से किए गए ट्रेड्स को वेरीफाई करने के लिए इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं।
 सुनिश्चित करें कि सेटलमेंट के 1 दिन के अंदर आपको फंड्स तथा सिक्योरीटीज़ का पेआउट मिल जाता है। यदि आपने फंड्स के रनिंग अकाउंट्स को चुना है, तो सुनिश्चित करें कि जैसा विकल्प चुना गया है, उसी के अनुसार आपके अकाउंट को हर महीने /तिमाही के पहले शुक्रवार/शनिवार को सेटल कर दिया जाता है।
 नकद सौदेबाजी प्रतिबंधित है। किसी भी सिक्योरीटीज़ को ब्रोकर या ब्रोकर के एसोसिएट या ब्रोकर के प्राधिकृत व्यक्ति को न दें। मार्जिन /कोलेट्रल के तौर पर सिक्योरीटीज़ को ब्रोकर को ट्रांसफर न करें तथा इस प्रकार की सिक्योरीटीज़ को केवल क्लाइंट डिमेट अकाउंट से ही प्लेज किया जाना चाहिए।
 डिलीवरी/सेटलमेंट बाध्यताओं के लिए सिक्योरीटीज़ के ट्रांसफर, मार्जिन के लिए सिक्योरीटीज़ को प्लेज करने की शुरुआत करने, तथा एक्सचेंज प्लेटफॉर्म पर म्यूचल फंड/ओपन ऑफर लेनदेनों के लिए ही डीडीपीआई (डिमेट डेबिट एण्ड प्लेज इंस्ट्रक्शन) का विकल्प चुनें। डीडीपीआई /पीओए वैकल्पिक हैं और अकाउंट खोलने के लिए उनके लिए जबरदस्ती नहीं की जानी चाहिए।
 अपने ब्रोकर के पास हमेशा अपने मोबाइल नम्बर तथा ईमेल आईडी को अपडेट रखें। ब्रोकर/एक्सचेंज द्वारा कॉन्ट्रेक्ट नोट्स/ट्रेड्स/फंड्स तथा सिक्योरीटीज़ बैलेंस के लिए भेजे गए एसएमएस /ईमेल को कभी भी नज़रअंदाज न करें। उसके ब्यौरे को सत्यापित कर लें और यदि कोई फर्क नज़र आता है, तो तत्काल अपने ब्रोकर को लिखित में उसकी सूचना दें।

 With reference to BSE notices 20210922-64 dated September 22, 2021 and 20211022-44 dated October 22, 2021, Stock Brokers are required to upload segregation and monitoring of collateral at client level on daily basis.

 Please note that negative number in the file represents debit balance/balance payable by you. Also, the funds and securities balances provided are what is maintained with your broker and does not include balance in your personal bank account and demat account.
 
 
 
 Yours faithfully,
 
 
  
 
 
 
 BSE Limited

 Do's & Dont's

 1. Deal only with registered intermediaries - check the registration certificate of the intermediary you are dealing with. It allows recourse to regulatory action.

 2. Beware of fixed/guaranteed returns schemes. Brokers or any of their representatives are not authorized to offer fixed/guaranteed returns on your investment or enter into any loan agreement to pay interest on the funds/securities offered by you.

 3. Do not fall prey to emails and SMSs luring you to trade in stock/ securities promising huge profits.

 4. Ensure to fill all the required details in KYC document by yourself and receive duly signed copy of your KYC documents from your broker. Check for all conditions that have been agreed and accepted by you.

 5. Opt for electronic (e-mail) contract notes/financial statements only if you are computer savvy and have an e-mail account of your own. Don't ignore any e-mails/SMSs received with regards to trades done by you. Verify the details of the same and report discrepancy, if any, to your broker in writing immediately

 6. Trade verification facility is also available on BSE website.

 7. Check the frequency of accounts settlement opted for and verify your monthly/quarterly settlement statements. Any discrepancies observed therein should be brought to the notice of your broker in writing immediately.

snippet: Dear Investor, With reference to SEBI circular ref no. CIR/MIRSD/15/2011dated August 02, 2011, a SMS and email facility has been provided for ease and convenience of verification of trades. Information
body:
Dear Investor,



 
With reference to SEBI circular ref no. CIR/MIRSD/15/2011dated August 02, 2011, a SMS and email facility has been provided for ease and convenience of verification of trades.


Information pertaining to your transactions (Traded value is quantity traded multiplied by trade price) for {{monthyear}} is attached below. Please follow the procedure given below for opening the attachment: 
 


1. Click on the attachment provided with this mail

2. You will be prompted for your password. 
 
3. The password is your PAN number in upper case.

4. Please check the first 3 letters of PAN provided in the mail attachment, to avoid mistakes 

 
The data is being provided to the clients on an "as is" and "where-is" basis, without any warranty. The Exchange shall not be liable for any delay or any other interruption which may occur in providing the data due to any reason including network (Internet) reasons or snags in the system, break down of the system or any other equipment, server breakdown, maintenance shutdown, breakdown of communication services or inability of the Exchange to send the data. In no event shall the Exchange be liable for any damages, including without limitation direct or indirect, special, incidental, or consequential damages, losses or expenses arising in connection with the data provided by the Exchange through this facility.
 



For Information & Education Purpose



We would like to draw your attention to "SEBI vide
circular dated April 04, 2022, wherein they have introduced the mechanism of “Demat Debit and Pledge Instruction (DDPI)”. The DDPI shall
serve the same purpose of POA and significantly mitigate the misuse of POA.



You should be
aware that the stockbroker and depository participant cannot directly /
indirectly compel the clients to execute the DDPI or deny services to the
client if the client refuses to execute the DDPI.



Please refer to SEBI Circular dated October 06, 2022,
for the list of instructions which client can give to its stockbroker /
depository participant. You may refer the following link for same:



https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/oct-2022/execution-of-demat-debit-and-pledge-instruction-ddpi-for-transfer-of-securities-towards-deliveries-settlement-obligations-and-pledging-re-pledging-of-securities-clarification_63724.html



Should you wish to give any instructions, these need
to be signed in physical against each purpose of DDPI. In case of an eSign option is made available, client should be given an
option to choose the specific purpose(s) of DDPI".


 Dos and Don’ts for Retail Investors: 



 
 
 

Please deal with SEBI registered intermediaries only. Ensure that you have complete knowledge of the products and the risks involved before investing.
Offering fixed/guaranteed/regular returns/ capital protection schemes in stock markets whether written or oral is not allowed. Brokers or any of their representatives or Authorised Persons cannot enter into any loan agreement to pay interest on the funds/securities offered by you.
Do not fall prey to emails, SMSs and online videos luring you to trade in stock/ securities / schemes promising high returns/profits.
Ensure to fill all the required details in the 'KYC' document by yourself and receive duly signed copy of your 'KYC' documents from your broker.
Trading in derivatives involves high risk and accordingly investors should understand the product well before trading in such segments/products.
Opt for electronic (e-mail) contract notes/financial statements only if you are computer savvy and have your own e-mail account.
Do not share your login ID, password, OTP, TPIN with any person including employees of the broker or Authorised Person under any circumstances.
Ensure that all your trades are executed as per your instructions.
Insure you receive the payout of funds and securities within 1 working day of settlement. In case you have chosen running account of funds, ensure your account is settled on first Friday of every month / quarter as opted for.
Dealing in cash is prohibited. Do not place any securities with the broker or associate of the broker or authorized person of the broker. Do not transfer securities as margin/ collateral to the broker and such securities only must be pledged from the client demat account.
Opt for Demat Debit and Pledge Instruction (DDPI) only for transfer of securities for deliveries/settlement obligations, initiating pledging of securities for margins, and for mutual fund/open offer transactions on Exchange platform. DDPI/PoA are optional and should not be insisted on for opening the account.
Always keep your mobile number and email id updated with your broker. Don't ignore any SMSs / e-mails with regards to contract notes/trades/funds and securities balances sent by broker/Exchange. Verify the details of the same and report discrepancy, if any, to your broker in writing immediately.
Make payments to SEBI registered intermediaries using a verified UPI ID. You may either scan a QR code or manually enter their UPI ID or check bank account details using SEBI check functionality: https://siportal.sebi.gov.in/intermediary/sebi-check This facility is also available through SEBI Saa₹thi app 
Claims for funds or securities given to the broker under any arrangement/ agreement of indicative return or claims for funds, without transactions on the Exchange will not be accepted by the Exchange in case of default by your broker.
For more details on Investor awareness, please visit-www.nseindia.com/invest/investors-home
For more information related to investments in securities market, please visit SEBI Investor Website https://investor.sebi.gov.in/ and SEBI Saa₹thi Mobile App.
SEBI has launched a free, voluntary online "Investor Certification Examination" aimed at enhancing investors' knowledge about Securities Market. To register and get your certificate - click on the link - https://sice.nism.ac.in/
Common Investor Service Centre(CISC): CISC offices are available across the country. For any queries or complaints, you may please reach out or visit the nearest CISC. The office address, email id, contact details and the link for locating the office have been provided in the link below: 
https://www.nseindia.com/static/contact/investor-services-centre


 


 निवेशक क्या करें और क्या न करें: 
 
	
 
 कृपया सिर्फ सेबी के यहां रजिस्टर्ड इंटरमीडयरीज़ के साथ ही डील करें। निवेश करने से पहले तय कर लें कि आप प्रोडक्ट्स तथा सम्बंधित जोखिम के बारे में पूरी जानकारी रखते हैं। 
 स्टॉक मार्केट में लिखित या मौखिक रूप से फिक्स्ड/ गारेंटेड/रेग्युलर रिटर्न्स/कैपिटल प्रोटेक्शन स्कीमों की ऑफर करने की अनुमति नहीं है। ब्रोकर्स या उनके किसी भी प्रतिनिधि या प्राधिकृत व्यक्तियों द्वारा आपके द्वारा ऑफर किए जाने वाले फंड्स /सिक्योरीटीज़ पर ब्याज के भुगतान के लिए लोन समझौता नहीं किया जा सकता है।
 हाई रिटर्न/लाभ का वादा करने वाले स्टॉक/सिक्योरीटीज़/स्कीमों में ट्रेड करने का लालच देने वाली ईमेल, एसएमएस तथा ऑनलाइन वीडियो पर भरोसा न करें।
 ‘केवाईसी’ दस्तावेज़ में सभी आवश्यक ब्यौरा स्वयं ही भरें और अपने ब्रोकर से अपने ‘केवाईसी’ दस्तावेज़ों की विधिवत रूप से साइन की गई प्रति को प्राप्त करें।
 डेरिवेटिव ट्रेडिंग में जोखिम हो सकते हैं और निवेशकों को किसी भी सम्बंधित उत्पाद में ट्रेड करने से पूर्व उसका पूर्ण ज्ञान और जानकारी लेना आवश्यक है।
 यदि आप कम्प्यूटर से बहुत भली-भांति परिचित हैं तथा आपका अपना ई-मेल अकाउंट है, केवल तभी ही इलेक्ट्रोनिक (ई-मेल) कॉन्ट्रेक्ट नोट्स / फाईनेंशियल स्टेटमेंट्स का विकल्प चुनें।
 किसी भी स्थिति में ब्रोकर के कर्मचारी या प्राधिकृत व्यक्ति सहित किसी भी व्यक्ति के साथ अपनी लॉगिन आईडी, पासवर्ड, ओटीपी और टी-पिन को साझा न करें।
 तय करें कि आपके सभी ट्रेड्स को आपके निर्देशों के अनुसार ही किया जाता है। एनएसई वेबसाइट पर ट्रेड वेरिफिकेशन सुविधा उपलब्ध है जिसे आपकी तरफ से किए गए ट्रेड्स को वेरीफाई करने के लिए इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं। 
 सुनिश्चित करें कि सेटलमेंट के 1 दिन के अंदर आपको फंड्स तथा सिक्योरीटीज़ का पेआउट मिल जाता है। यदि आपने फंड्स के रनिंग अकाउंट्स को चुना है, तो सुनिश्चित करें कि जैसा विकल्प चुना गया है, उसी के अनुसार आपके अकाउंट को हर महीने /तिमाही के पहले शुक्रवार को सेटल कर दिया जाता है।
 नकद सौदेबाजी प्रतिबंधित है। किसी भी सिक्योरीटीज़ को ब्रोकर या ब्रोकर के एसोसिएट या ब्रोकर के प्राधिकृत व्यक्ति को न दें। मार्जिन /कोलेट्रल के तौर पर सिक्योरीटीज़ को ब्रोकर को ट्रांसफर न करें तथा इस प्रकार की सिक्योरीटीज़ को केवल क्लाइंट डिमेट अकाउंट से ही प्लेज किया जाना चाहिए।
 डिलीवरी/सेटलमेंट बाध्यताओं के लिए सिक्योरीटीज़ के ट्रांसफर, मार्जिन के लिए सिक्योरीटीज़ को प्लेज करने की शुरुआत करने, तथा एक्सचेंज प्लेटफॉर्म पर म्यूचल फंड/ओपन ऑफर लेनदेनों के लिए ही डीडीपीआई (डिमेट डेबिट एण्ड प्लेज इंस्ट्रक्शन) का विकल्प चुनें। डीडीपीआई /पीओए वैकल्पिक हैं और अकाउंट खोलने के लिए उनके लिए जबरदस्ती नहीं की जानी चाहिए।
 अपने ब्रोकर के पास हमेशा अपने मोबाइल नम्बर तथा ईमेल आईडी को अपडेट रखें। ब्रोकर/एक्सचेंज द्वारा कॉन्ट्रेक्ट नोट्स/ट्रेड्स/फंड्स तथा सिक्योरीटीज़ बैलेंस के लिए भेजे गए एसएमएस /ईमेल को कभी भी नज़रअंदाज न करें। उसके ब्यौरे को सत्यापित कर लें और यदि कोई फर्क नज़र आता है, तो तत्काल अपने ब्रोकर को लिखित में उसकी सूचना दें।
 सत्यापित यूपीआई आईडी का उपयोग करके सेबी पंजीकृत मध्यस्थों को भुगतान करें। सेबी चेक कार्यक्षमता का उपयोग करके आप या तो क्यूआर कोड को स्कैन कर सकते हैं या मैन्युअल रूप से उनकी यूपीआई आईडी दर्ज कर सकते हैं या बैंक खाते के विवरण की जांच कर सकते हैं: https://siportal.sebi.gov.in/intermediary/sebi-check यह सुविधा सेबी Saa₹thi ऐप के माध्यम से भी उपलब्ध है। 
 एक्सचेंज में लेनदेन के बिना, ब्रोकर को किसी भी समझौते/ भावी रिटर्न के समझौते या फंड्स के दावों के लिए दिए गए फंड्स या सिक्योरीटीज़ के दावों को एक्सचेंज द्वारा स्वीकार नहीं किया जाएगा यदि आपका ब्रोकर कोई डिफाल्ट करता है।
 निवेशक जागरूकता के संबंध में अधिक ब्यौरे के लिए कृपया निम्नलिखित को देखें-www.nseindia.com/invest/investors-home
 प्रतिभूति बाजार में निवेश से संबंधित अधिक जानकारी के लिए कृपया सेबी निवेशक वेबसाइट https://investor.sebi.gov.in/ और सेबी सा₹थी / Saa₹thi मोबाइल ऐप पर जाएं। 
 सेबी ने प्रतिभूति बाजार के बारे में निवेशकों के ज्ञान को बढ़ाने के उद्देश्य से एक निःशुल्क, स्वैच्छिक ऑनलाइन "Investor Certification Examination" शुरू की है। पंजीकरण करने और अपना प्रमाणपत्र प्राप्त करने के लिए https://sice.nism.ac.in/ पर क्लिक करें।
 सकॉमन इन्वेस्टर सर्विस सेंटर (CISC): CISC कार्यालय देशभर में उपलब्ध हैं। किसी भी प्रश्न या शिकायत के लिए, कृपया निकटतम CISC कार्यालय से संपर्क करें या निकटतम CISC कार्यालय पर जा सकते हैं। । कार्यालय का पता, ईमेल, संपर्क विवरण और कार्यालय खोजने के लिए लिंक नीचे दिए गए हैं: 
 https://www.nseindia.com/static/contact/investor-services-centre	
 
 
	
 
We are glad to inform you that NSE for your convenience/comfort is providing links below on investment concepts, investor alerts, your rights and obligation as an investor.



www.nseindia.com/invest/first-time-investor-know-your-rights
www.nseindia.com/invest/first-time-investor-fraud-dos-and-donts
www.nseindia.com/invest/file-a-complaint-online

You may also visit our website www.nseindia.com for any further information that you may require or e-mail your queries to the e-mail ID ignse@nse.co.in, quoting name of your city in the subject. We would be glad to assist you. 



 

 Information to investors: 

Exchange has introduced trading in Rights Entitlement w.e.f. May 20, 2020. The trades executed, if any, for Rights Entitlement in Capital Market shall form part of the attached file. Rights Entitlement should not be mistaken for ordinary shares and unless Rights Entitlement are exercised they will lose value and no rights (shares) will be available to the investor. The buyer of the Rights Entitlement is required to subscribe for the same before the Issue Closing Date, else the same will lapse and no shares will be allotted.


In case you need any clarification, please feel free to call on our toll free number 1800 266 0050 (select option 5 - UCI & Trade Alerts). You can also email us at uci@nse.co.in, quoting your PAN, Mobile no. and your query.





Thanks and Regards, 

 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited

subject: Attention Investors: Beware of Unauthorized Groups/Individuals Claiming Association with Angel One
snippet: Attention Investors! - Fraud Alert Dear Investor, It has come to our attention that certain individuals (imposters) using the alias Shraddha Singh are falsely claiming association with Angel One
body:
Fraud Alert Dear Investor, It has come to our attention that certain individuals (imposters) using the alias Shraddha Singh are falsely claiming association with Angel One Limited through WhatsApp groups, social media platforms, and other digital communication channels. These imposters often impersonate Angel One’s senior leadership or pose as assistants to our senior leadership attempting to mislead investors. The imposters may also promote or operate through unauthorized applications such as “Trendlytic”. The imposters may also circulate misleading statements, fabricated profit screenshots, and unauthorized investment recommendations to lure investors into
transferring money to unknown or personal accounts. We advise users to exercise caution, refrain from engaging with such entities, and promptly delete or report any such apps or communication if encountered. Further, this is to inform that an individual named Hari, operating through mobile number 7825973621, is deceptively using the Angel One name to provide securities market tips and assure returns on investment through a profit-sharing arrangement. Please Note the Following: Angel One executives or employees do not provide investment advice or recommendations through WhatsApp, Telegram, or social media groups. Always engage only through Angel One’s verified and official platforms. Angel One Limited has no association with any such WhatsApp, Telegram, or social media groups offering stock tips, IPO recommendations, or guaranteed returns. Angel One has reported these impersonation activities to the relevant authorities and continues to take proactive steps to protect investors. Important Advisory Angel One Limited shall not be responsible or liable for any financial losses incurred as a result of engaging with such fraudulent individuals or groups. Any interaction with unauthorized entities claiming association with Angel One is done entirely at the investor s own risk. What You Can Do If you have been approached by, or have fallen victim to, such impersonation or fraud attempts, we strongly recommend that you Call 1930, the National Cyber Crime Helpline. Lodge a complaint with the nearest Cyber Crime Police Station or online at https://www.cybercrime.gov.in. Report suspicious activity to Angel One through our official support channels. Stay alert. Stay informed.

 Universitas Indonesia (UI) has announced the Call for Nominations and
Applications (Batch 2) for the Student Exchange and Fee-Paying Study Abroad
Program at Universitas Indonesia for the Odd (Fall) Semester of Academic
Year 2026/2027 (August–December 2026).


*Extended Nomination and Application Deadline: 07 June 2026*
For exchange students, tuition fees at Universitas Indonesia are waived
during the exchange period. For fee-paying study abroad students, tuition
fees for international students at Universitas Indonesia will apply.

The study clusters available include:

 - Health
 - Science and Technology
 - Social and Humanities

Further information about fee-paying study abroad programs, offered
courses, Fact Sheet and Nomination Form, can be found in this link:
international.ui.ac.id/exchange-program/ and in the attachments.

academic journey at UI for the Fall/Odd Semester 2026/2027!*
To provide further information about these opportunities and
programs, interactive online information sessions via Zoom will be hosted.
To accommodate participants from different time zones, two sessions will be
offered:

 - Session 1: Friday, 29 May 2026 at 16:00 Jakarta Time (GMT+7)
 - Session 2: Saturday, 30 May 2026 at 07:00 Jakarta Time (GMT+7)


*Kindly RSVP through the following link: bit.ly/UI_InfoSession_NonDegree

AutoRABIT- Super Dream Internship


We are delighted to invite students from *Vellore institute of technology* to
participate in our Software Engineering Internship Hiring Drive scheduled
on May 29, 2026.

AutoRABIT is a global leader in DevSecOps for Salesforce, providing
enterprise-grade solutions trusted by leading organisations worldwide. As
part of our continued growth, we are looking to engage passionate and
talented Java engineering students through a structured internship program
that offers strong learning exposure and a potential pathway to full-time
employment.


*INTERNSHIP DETAILS*

· *Role:* Software Engineering Intern

· *Internship Duration:* June 2026 – December 2026 (6 Months)

· *Stipend:* ₹65000 Per Month for the complete intern

· *Work Mode:* Hybrid – Hyderabad

· *Full-Time Opportunity:* High-performing interns will be
considered for full-time roles

· *Eligible Programs : * M.Tech / MCA – Computer Science or related
streams

· *Eligibility: *Final-year students or recent graduates

· *Hiring Drive Date :* May 29, 2026


*SELECTION PROCESS*

 1. Resume Screening
 2. In-Person Technical & HR Interview – Hyderabad

Please note that candidates shortlisted after resume screening will be
required to attend the in-person interview round at our Hyderabad office.

Shortlisted students should be prepared to travel to Hyderabad accordingly.
We request the Placement Cell to kindly communicate this clearly to all
participating students in advance.


*CANDIDATE PROFILE – IMPORTANT*

We are specifically looking for students who:

✅ Have strong knowledge of Java programming and Core Java fundamentals
✅ Possess good analytical, logical reasoning, and communication skills
✅ Have worked on real-time or academic projects using Java technologies
✅ Demonstrate strong learning ability and problem-solving mindset

We kindly request that you share profiles that closely align with the above
requirements.

*Please avoid sharing profiles where:*
• Primary expertise is in Python, C, C++, AI/ML, Data Science, or non-Java
technologies
• Projects are not Java-based

Only relevant profiles will be considered for further evaluation.

subject: 5 reasons to attend AWS Summit India Online
snippet: Last chance to register for this free event that's helping tech teams be more productive. AWS Logo AWS Summit Online India Your final opportunity to register AWS Summit India Online on June 3, 2026
body:
Last chance to register for this free event that's helping tech teams be more productive.
https://email.awscloud.com/MTEyLVRaTS03NjYAAAGiAcSz8-w97uo9qcsCJlI__wkgjcQfugbmDu6dAKsV5lnJCiC-Oh6dqiycCSiB1p1D-e004BI=

Your final opportunity to register
--------------

AWS Summit India Online on June 3, 2026 is your opportunity to dive deep into AWS service architectures, implementation patterns, and production-grade solutions. This complimentary technical conference is built for engineers, architects, DevOps practitioners, and ML engineers who want to master AWS infrastructure and services.

Register now for 1 days of cloud architecture and AI deep-dives, live demos, and technical sessions covering everything from container orchestration to distributed AI systems.
--------------

Register now 
https://email.awscloud.com/MTEyLVRaTS03NjYAAAGiAcSz8-w97uo9qcsCJlI__wkgjcQfugbmDu6dAKsV5lnJCiC-Oh6dqiycCSiB1p1D-e004BI=
--------------

5 ways this event will help your workloads

1. Breaking AI product launches
Hear Madhusudan Rao, CTO, Swiggy reveal how organizations are deploying advanced AI systems that scale and get early access to new AI capabilities.

2. Technical sessions
Master the latest in cloud architecture and AI through practical sessions designed for technical teams looking to enhance their cloud and AI capabilities.

3. Interactive Expo
Get hands-on experience with AWS’s latest technology, test advanced AI models, and experiment with new tools alongside technical experts.

4. Technical certification pathway
Fast-track your or your team's technical expertise with focused preparation for AWS's most advanced certifications.

5. AWS Partner spotlight
Discover how leading technology partners are building sophisticated solutions on AWS and learn about proven implementation patterns.
--------------

Register today

Kind Attention!!

Infosys shortlisted students.

Infosys interviews are scheduled on 27-05-2026, 28-05-2026, and 29-05-2026
at SRM Kattankulathur Campus.

 -

 Shortlisted students who are yet to complete their interviews are
 requested to kindly check your email and attend the interviews as per the
 schedule.
 -

 *Students who have already completed their interviews but still receive
 interview emails may kindly ignore them.*
 -

 Please note that a few L3 interviews will be scheduled on later dates.
 Infosys will share the updated interview schedule separately.


Warm regards.

*Dr.V.Samuel Rajkumar,PhD*

Director(Career Development Centre)

VIT, Vellore

*V**ellore Institute of Technology (VIT), India -*

 Science and AI, Mathematics, Material Science, Mechanical, and
 Manufacturing subjects are within the top 200 in the world * *(QS World
 University Rankings by Subject 2026)*

*Internship Profile / JD :*

We are looking for a high-energy, curious Software Engineering Intern to
join our development teams in Bazaarvoice. This isn't a "get us coffee"
kind of internship. You will be integrated into a team, writing
production-ready code, participating in sprint cycles, and solving problems
that impact our global user base. *Key Responsibilities* Feature
Development: Assist in the design, development, and testing of new features
using modern frameworks. Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and
efficient code while participating in peer code reviews. Bug Squashing:
Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to mitigate these
issues. Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers and Designers to
transform wireframes into functional prototypes. Learning: Stay updated
with emerging trends in Cloud Computing, AI/ML, and Backend
Architecture. *Requirements
& Qualifications* *Education*: M.Tech final year in Computer Science,
Information Technology, or a related field. Technical Foundations: Strong
grasp of Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA). Tech Stack (Preferred): *
Languages: Proficiency in at least one modern language (e.g., Python, Java,
or JavaScript/TypeScript). Frontend: Familiarity with React.js or Vue.js.
Backend: Basic understanding of RESTful APIs and Database management
(SQL/NoSQL). Tools: Agentic AI tools, Basic knowledge of Git/GitHub and
Linux environments. Soft Skills: A proactive "builder" mindset and the
ability to articulate technical concepts clearly. Perks & Benefits
Competitive Stipend: Market-standard monthly compensation. Mentorship:
Direct access to senior engineers and architects.



***All the interested and eligible students are asked to register in the
NEO PAT on or before *26th May 2026 (9.00 AM)*


*No Manual Registration & extension will be entertained. *


*Mandatory Note: *


1. Branches, eligibility and date for the selection process are tentative
and subject to change.

2. Please update your resume with all relevant details and projects done,
in Campus interaction Portal as there would be shortlisting by the company
for the selection process.

3. Appear for the selection process in formal dress.

4. Carry your updated Resumes, photos, College photo ID and all other
relevant certificates.

 before the selection process.
5. Late comers will not be allowed to attend the selection process.

body:
Dear Students,

Greetings!

Qualcomm Academy is excited to offer students its unique 5G University
Program. Through this program, you may enroll in free 5G training, receive
a Qualcomm Technologies certification, and have a chance to get noticed by
Qualcomm recruiters! I encourage you to take advantage of this opportunity,
as this is a chance for you to build your CV and skills in a high-demand
field.

Enrolling in the program only takes five minutes. You may follow the steps
below to start learning today:
1.Create Your Qualcomm Academy Account: Please *create your account here
*.
2. Select Your Courses: First, make sure you’re logged into your new
account. Then, click on the two courses below and click “Add To Cart” for
each course. Please ensure both courses are in your cart before you proceed
to checkout.
·*5G Primer *: A
broad two-hour introductory course for business and/or engineering students
who are new to the field of wireless engineering.
·*Fundamentals of Cellular Communication and 5G
*
:

A
more in-depth six-hour introductory course with some technical components,
also geared toward business and/or engineering students new to the field.
3. Complete the Checkout Process: Once the two courses above are in your
cart and proceed to checkout. Once you’re on the checkout page, apply the
following coupon code: 5GUP-VVEL. Once you complete the checkout process,
you can view your courses in the “My Courses” tab at the top right of the
page.
4. Register for Your 5G Introductory-Level Certification Exam (Optional): If
you would like to take the 5G Introductory-Level Certification Exam, you
may register here
.
The exam is online and costs $29.* A total of 50 UG Students will be
selected to receive a COUPON CODE to take the exam free of cost. The
details will be sent to you during the 1st week of July 2026.* If If you
pass the exam, you will receive a Qualcomm Technologies 5G certificate, and the
Academy will notify Qualcomm recruiters that you passed, which may give you
a leg-up in the interview process.

Best regards,
Sivanantham Sathasivam
Director, V-SPACE

*आदरणीय महोदया/महोदय,Respected Sir/Madam,*


"Kindly disseminate and upload this announcement via website/ Letter/
official channels to all the faculty, students, and officials, inviting
their active participation in the Upcoming India Space Lab: Summer
Internship & Technical Training Program

We encourage you to read more about the Hon'ble Prime Minister's thoughts
on India's remarkable space journey in his *Mann Ki Baat program in August
2024,* where he shared his thoughts on India Space Week and its
significance and appreciated its contribution.

Following the notice issued on December 8, 2023, regarding the online
meeting on "Viksit Bharat @2047: Voice of Youth," referenced as F.1-1/2023(
secy/ViksitBharat@2047
),
we are pleased to announce that the Prime Minister has launched "Viksit
Bharat @2047" on December 11, 2023.

The Government of India, under the visionary leadership of Hon'ble PM Shri
Narendra Modi, has initiated groundbreaking reforms in the space sector.
These reforms aim to promote and advance space education, research, and
development in our country. Following the successful of India Space Week &
National Space Day event held in August, 2024 and an Advanced Drone
workshop /Internship Technical Training Programme /Cyber Security Awareness
Program/Astronomy and Astrophysics/Space Entrepreneurship/ Distaster
management/ conducted across universities and offical Departments.In
continuation, The India Space Lab has launched a Summer internship
technical training program - 2026 for all ( Space Education & Employment ).

*Upcoming India Space Lab:Summer Internship & Technical Training Program.*

*About Summer Internship :*

Undergraduate and postgraduate students and research scholars in recognized
universities or institutions in India and abroad can apply for the India
Space Lab Summer Internship. Participants will work closely with various
verticals, divisions, and cells of Space and receive training in Drone
Technology, CanSat and CubeSat (Student Satellite), Rocketry, Remote
Sensing (GIS), Disaster Management.This internship will be conducted
online, with no stipend provision.



*Registration :- The Summer internship has total of two Batches. The
registration timeline for both the batches is as follow.*

*Dear Faculty Members**,*
Greetings from Tata Technologies!

We are pleased to invite your esteemed institution to participate in *Tata
Technologies InnoVent-27**, *which is India’s largest innovation-driven
hackathon, designed exclusively for *3rd & 4th Year* *engineering students*
*.* The hackathon focuses on real-world problem solving, innovation, and
prototype development, providing students with hands-on industry exposure.

*Benefits for Institution and Students**:*

 - Cash prizes up to *₹ 4,50,000* *(1st: ₹ 3,00,000 | 2nd: *₹ *1,00,000 |
 3rd: *₹ *50,000). *
 - *Job opportunities / paid internship offers at Tata Technologies* for
 top-performing participants.
 - One-year full access to the* iGET IT* – Tata Technologies learning
 platform, including over *15,000+ *courses.
 - CLAD (*Certified LabVIEW Associate Developer) *certification
 opportunity.
 - AWS platform access with latest features to develop POC (Proof of
 Concept).
 - Training & guidance on *Tata Technologies Innovation Framework, Edge
 AI.*
 - *Personal Mentorship* by industry experts for developing your projects.
 - Opportunity to present your solution/POC at a national-level hackathon
 in front of industry leaders.
 - Branding through Tata Technologies social media handles.
 - Recognition and acknowledgment from industry leaders.
 - Direct engagement with Tata Technologies *HR team. *
 - Strengthening *placement collaboration* and corporate relations.
 - Institutional visibility for winning teams on Tata Technologies social
 media / print media.


*Eligibility Criteria for participation*:

 - All engineering students of 3rd and 4th year.
 - Team size : minimum 1, maximum 5.
 - Multiple entries allowed.
 - No participation charges.

*InnoVent-27 tentative event timeline**:*

*Timeline*
*Activity*

registration details revealed)

Stage 2 results announcement

Final demo day / presentation day

subject: Summer School in Computational Biology – From Molecules to Tissues, in Portugal-September 1st to September 12th, 2026.

snippet: Dear Students, We are pleased to inform you that applications are now open for the Summer School in Computational Biology – From Molecules to Tissues, which will be held in Coimbra, Portugal, from
body:
Dear Students,

We are pleased to inform you that applications are now open for the *Summer
School in Computational Biology – From Molecules to Tissues*, which will be
held in *Coimbra, Portugal*, from *September 1st to September 12th, 2026*.

This international summer school will provide participants with an
excellent opportunity to gain advanced knowledge and practical exposure in
the field of computational biology, covering topics from molecular-level
analysis to tissue-scale modeling.

The program is expected to include lectures, workshops, collaborative
activities, and interactions with international experts and researchers.

Students interested in computational biology, bioinformatics, systems
biology, biomedical engineering, and related interdisciplinary areas are
strongly encouraged to apply.

Please find the detailed announcement and application information attached
herewith.

Link to Apply:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/136KkAoNZNsCEU2cahGrML9Sk_8bjOTg1IO4jdtv-bwM/edit?usp=drivesdk



Best Regards,

R Seenivasan

body:
Kind Attention:

This is a kind reminder regarding the registration for the *Skill Building
and Career Enhancement Program*, open to all students from the 2027 and
2028 batches at your esteemed campus.

 Continuing our year-on-year partnership, we request you to kindly forward
this email to your students and request them to join *Amazon Wow,
* a channel for
skill building and career enhancement for women engineer Students and
complete *registration
*.







*Why join WoW?*

Be part of a program designed to support career readiness for women in tech
and other careers. WoW will help you expand your network, learn about
different career paths, and build your leadership skills. Plus you’ll meet
women who will inspire you to keep moving forward.



*What you'll learn*

Our programming is designed to help you gain essential skills, discover
your ideal career, and get ready for your Amazon application and beyond.





*Frequently asked questions*

*Who's eligible to participate?*

Amazon WoW is open to all students who are studying at university or who
have graduated within the last 24 months.

*Where can I register for the sessions?*

Click on "Register now" icon on top of the page

*Will this portal allow access to job opportunities at Amazon? If yes,
where can I find them?*

The Amazon University team will periodically reach out to students
registered through the Amazon WoW portal to seek interest in full-time
graduate and internship opportunities.

*Is there a cost to participate?*

No. WoW is a free program with no membership fees.
